findings.title: Reached recursive metadata dependencies never enter the isolation graph
findings.description: localTarget invokes the complete physical metadata census for a reached nonRoot package, but discards its returned manifest set. The graph loop then consults only metadata.cache.get(pkgFile), the nearest context manifest. Valid nested package.json actors and locally reached children are read and cached without an edge linking them to the reached actor or traversing their dependencies. A nested dist manifest can therefore declare a workspace product dependency and the native CLI reports PASS with no diagnostics or violations.
findings.contract: Each reached nonRoot physical actor governs recursive metadata, including dist; declared workspace/file/link/npm edges must retain the product boundary.
findings.expected: FAIL for known product dependency (at minimum blocking, never PASS).
findings.observed: 16 distinct inert fixtures return PASS / native CLI exit 0 across all four dependency fields, direct workspace names, npm aliases, file URLs and transitive local metadata.
findings.controls: All 12 nearest-context workspace/alias/file product controls report FAIL. All corresponding opaque and Root-ancestor-only archives stay PASS; no proposal expands Root census.
findings.requiredCorrection: Connect every governed reached-context manifest to its actor; traverse its complete dependency closure using canonical physical identity, including nested and recursively followed local actors. Preserve Root documentary scope.

findings.title: Nested local metadata can erase an unknown dependency frontier
findings.description: The nearest-context path emits UNVERIFIED_LOCAL_DEPENDENCY for a valid physical local package outside declared workspaces. The identical local dependency in nested governed metadata is visited only by the manifest reader, so neither a dependency graph edge nor a blocking diagnostic is added. Native CLI returns PASS. This is the unknown-frontier consequence of the same disconnected actor set described in F1.
findings.contract: Every reachable unknown blocks INCOMPLETE; no broad omissions for nested or local dependency metadata.
findings.expected: INCOMPLETE until the nonworkspace local implementation closure is independently established.
findings.observed: Four nested local controls return PASS / exit 0; four otherwise identical nearest-context controls return INCOMPLETE / exit 1.
findings.requiredCorrection: After connecting metadata actors, either fully audit a declared physical local target or retain its unknown diagnostic on the reachable actor. Shape validation alone cannot close its frontier.
